title: Sports Illustrated Resorts Nashville 2BR Suite
description:
Sports Illustrated Resorts Nashville places you in the heart of Music Row, steps from Broadway’s honky-tonks, Vanderbilt, and legendary studios. Catch SEC matchups, NFL games, or a show at the Ryman — all minutes away. Enjoy signature spaces like the Trophy Lounge and Outfield Pool, plus spacious studio, one-, and two-bedroom suites. It’s your home field for celebrating, relaxing, and soaking up Nashville’s energy.

The space
At Sports Illustrated Resorts Nashville, modern studio, one- and two-bedroom accommodations comfortably sleep two to six guests and offer thoughtfully designed spaces with convenient amenities. Each apartment-style unit features a washer and dryer and a fully equipped kitchen to ensure you feel right at home. Fast, reliable Wi-Fi, floor-to-ceiling windows, and private balconies (in select units) further enhance your stay.

Guest access
Set in the heart of Nashville’s electric SoBro district, Sports Illustrated Resorts Nashville rises above the rhythm of the city with apartment-style living and resort amenities. Take in striking views of downtown from the rooftop pool or step outside and find yourself just moments away from the iconic honky-tonks of Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, and the very soul of Music City. Whether you're in town for the tunes, the food, or the Southern charm, this is the perfect home base for discovering Nashville like a local.
